palermo.body: Find a green pause among the neighbourhood’s parks and gardens.

chainActivity.title: Passport on Stellar
chainActivity.body: Your passport, purchases and collected stamps are recorded automatically on Stellar testnet.
chainActivity.consent: Passport registration, verified purchases, QR stamps and self-reported exploration stamps are recorded automatically on Stellar testnet. Direct exploration claims do not verify a visit or award reputation. Your wallet, counters and pseudonymous event identifiers are public and persistent. Names, emails, hotel details and QR credentials are not published. CityPassport pays the recording fees.
chainActivity.delayed: Stellar confirmation is delayed. We are retrying automatically.

agentPurchase.title: Authorize an agent purchase
agentPurchase.description: Let your travel agent pay for one destination pass on Stellar testnet.
agentPurchase.scope: One pass · 100 testnet USDC · expires in 15 minutes. The pass and reputation belong to your passport. This development pass includes no venue admission or discounts.
agentPurchase.consent: I authorize this wallet to pay 100 testnet USDC for this pass for my passport.
agentPurchase.secretNote: Copy this credential now and share it only with your agent. It authorizes this purchase only and is not shown again after leaving this page.
agentPurchase.instructions: The agent sends this credential in the Authorization: Bearer header. The endpoint returns x402 payment requirements. Keep it out of URLs, logs and chat transcripts.
agentPurchase.revokeFailed: Unable to revoke. Payment may already be processing; check your passport before authorizing another purchase.
